verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents an Admin/Management API with full dashboard parity. It covers creating, updating and deleting projects, environments, flags, segments and users, and is backed by a separate public Flags API using environment keys. An official MCP server wraps that API for agents. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes of the candidate paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: This is the API you use to programmatically manage your Flagsmith projects. Anything you can do in the Flagsmith dashboard, you can also do via the Admin API.
Purpose: Creating, updating, and deleting projects, environments, flags, segments, and users.
The Flagsmith MCP Server gives AI assistants and agents programmatic access to the Flagsmith Admin API through the Model Context Protocol
